summary.headline: Judgments on Beasts and Livestock
summary.text: Astrological judgment on animals and livestock: benefic aspects and Mars’s dignities indicate abundance, love of horses, arms, and hunting, while Saturn in a fixed twelfth sign brings sadness or impediment through beasts. Mars’s oriental position in Aries, Leo, Sagittarius, Taurus, Virgo, or Capricorn distinguishes horses, camels, large animals, cattle, cows, and beasts of burden.
